subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Necessary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Essential**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"necessary"** means something that is required or needed; it is something that must be done or achieved. (आवश्यक)

 
 
• **Example: **It is necessary to have a valid passport for international travel.
 
 
 
• **"Essential" **refers to something absolutely necessary; extremely important. (मूलभूत)
 
 
• **Example: **Water is essential for all forms of life.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'necessary' **is **'essential'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Essential**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Powerful **(शक्तिशाली): Having great power or strength.

 
 
• **Example:** The powerful engine of the car made the journey smooth and fast.
 
 
 
• **Existential **(अस्तित्व संबंधी): Relating to existence or the experience of being.
 
 
• **Example: **The philosopher had an existential crisis about the meaning of life.
 
 
 
• **Spatial** (स्थानिक): Relating to space and the position, size, shape, etc., of things within it.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist has a remarkable spatial awareness that helps him create stunning sculptures.
